rationale_one_line: ProofShot diagnoses then prescribes; that's the CLASSIC arc verbatim. Gallery's white canvas + IBM Plex Serif gives it canonical-tool gravity, and a terminal scene as visual hero shows the verification flow instead of narrating it.
writing_tone_notes: Calm declarative founder voice. Diagnosis first, then fix. Trust the reader. Contractions where natural. The verdict carries the praise.
do_rules: Lead the caption with 'topped Show HN', not stars (817 is modest, momentum is the story).
Use a terminal scene as the visual hero so the CLI flow reads viscerally.
Land 'before you trust' on the fix beat — that's the verification gate.
Cover the multi-agent compatibility (Claude Code / Cursor / Codex) in the caption.
dont_rules: No mention of v1.6.0 or any release number.
No SCHEMATIC, RECEIPT, mono-terminal, subway-chrome (already shipped today).
